external_entities.notes: The text refers to multiple calling backends but does not identify them separately.

processes.name: Inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server, and writes requests and responses to the inference log.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: Callers pass an API key in a header. Keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

processes.name: Model server
processes.description: The server that runs the actual model on GPU nodes, loads model artifacts at startup, and reads customer features from Redis.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: The model server uses its own service account to load model artifacts.

data_stores.name: Model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup and used as the destination for newly published model artifacts.
data_stores.notes: The text says the artifacts are trusted and does not state that their integrity is verified. The speaker is unsure what governs who can push and thinks it may be a shared group account.

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features, including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: Inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every inference request and response for debugging, including raw prompts that may contain calling-team users' typed input.
data_stores.source_excerpt: an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging

assumptions.assumption: The inference gateway presents a web interface because it is described as a FastAPI service.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the gateway as a FastAPI service, which presents an HTTP-family application interface.

assumptions.assumption: The customer features in the Redis feature store are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The store contains account age and spend bands per customer, which are customer-related and financial information.
The log contains raw prompts that sometimes carry whatever calling-team users typed, so its contents may include information whose disclosure could harm a person or business.
